claims.value: seven HEK WT EThcD-only raw files at supplemental activation NCE 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, and 40
claims.evidence: Every filename has HEK_WT, an EThcD-only method token, its NCE setting, and a matching accession-scoped PRIDE raw-file record. Paper Figure 1 and Methods describe the aliquoted enriched HEK293 sample and EThcD-only energy series.

claims.location: source name, characteristics[organism], characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], rows 1-7
claims.value: one HEK293 wild-type Jacalin-enriched glycopeptide preparation; CVCL_0045
claims.evidence: Paper Methods identify HEK293 wild-type cells, trypsin digest, neuraminidase treatment and Jacalin enrichment. Figure 1 caption says enriched glycopeptides were aliquoted before the method comparison. Cellosaurus CVCL_0045 identifies HEK293. Biological replicate 1 identifies that one described preparation; additional independent biological sources are not claimed.

Figure 1 describes aliquoted samples; the seven deposited raw filenames are distinct injections with distinct NCE settings. The ordinal is assigned from NCE order for SDRF coordinate uniqueness, not a laboratory-provided replicate number.

claims.location: comment[instrument] and comment[cleavage agent details], rows 1-7
claims.evidence: Paper Experimental Section and matching PRIDE protocols name both.

Paper Methods specify full-scan MS, precursor-selected MS/MS, dynamic exclusion for 30 seconds, a 10-ppm exclusion window and 3-second duty cycle for all methods. This is a DDA acquisition scheme, although the text does not use the DDA acronym.

claims.location: comment[dissociation method], comment[collision energy], factor value[supplemental activation energy], rows 1-7
claims.evidence: Paper Methods and Figure 1 define an EThcD-only series with varied supplemental activation energies. Each exact NCE value is in its deposited filename. PSI-MS accession MS:1002631 denotes electron transfer and higher-energy collision dissociation.

claims.value: fixed C carbamidomethyl; variable M oxidation, HexNAc and Hex(1)HexNAc(1) on S/T/Y
claims.evidence: Paper Data Analysis explicitly lists these search modifications. UNIMOD:43 and UNIMOD:793 identify the two glycan compositions. Y is retained because it is explicitly included in the paper's search sites, even though the UNIMOD record lists narrower experimentally curated site specificity.

limitations: Only seven EThcD-only HEK293 RAW acquisitions are annotated. The 16 sequential HCD/ETciD or HCD/EThcD HEK acquisitions and the two TMT-labeled HepG2 RAW files require separate method and channel mapping.

PRIDE marks the project-level quantification method TMT, but the paper explicitly identifies the HEK293 comparison as unlabeled and reserves TMT for the HepG2 comparison. The seven selected files have HEK_WT and no TMT token.
The official offline validator emits one warning for the PSI-MS EThcD term MS:1002631, which is supported by the PSI-MS CV but absent from the validator's local ontology cache.

The publication does not provide a biological replicate count beyond the aliquoted HEK293 preparation. The SDRF's biological replicate 1 designates the described preparation, without claiming an independent replicate series.
